verdict.rationale: First-party docs say a first parse job can run from the Web UI with no code [docs-1], and that you can drag and drop any supported document into LlamaParse to extract data against a defined schema [docs-14]. A hands-on community user confirms the interface exists but found it confusing, with table output not shown in tabular form [comm-3]. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the parse playground's result preview, clear evidence that parse results (not just extract) display interactively after drag-and-drop, positive independent corroboration of the playground experience.
